compute_euler_angle_error: compute the Euler angle error between predicted and target rotation matrices for motion prediction
calculate_euler_diff_for_joints: calculate the L2 Euler angle error across all joints from rotation matrix predictions and targets
evaluate_motion_prediction_accuracy: evaluate motion prediction accuracy by computing Euler angle differences between predicted and ground truth poses
compare_rotation_matrices: compare predicted rotation matrices against target rotation matrices and return per-sample Euler angle error
filter_low_variance_joints: filter out low-variance joint angles when computing Euler angle error to focus on meaningful motion differences
